excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的有毒大气层内观测到的生命信号，是体型庞大的半有机机械体！这个外星工业体似乎正是星球上乌烟瘴气的罪魁祸首，而且它依旧在运转。这个星球上没有其他的生命信号，这些机械体的造物主肯定抛下它们自己跑掉了。我们目前还不能确定它们的意图，但是它们建造的建筑想必能够帮助我们更好地理解工程学。

texts.en: The life signs observed within the toxic atmosphere of [From.GetName] are giant semi-organic machines! This alien industry seems to have been the cause of the noxious atmosphere on the planet, yet it's still operational. No other life signs remain on the world, and the creators of these machines must have left them running. texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的有毒大气层内观测到的生命信号，是体型庞大的半有机机械体！正如我们一样，看上去这个设施的创造者也很青睐生物和机械的融合之美。这个外星工业体似乎正是星球上乌烟瘴气的罪魁祸首，而且它依旧在运转。这个星球上没有其他的生命信号，这些机械体的造物主肯定抛下它们自己跑掉了。我们目前还不能确定它们的意图，但是它们建造的建筑想必能够帮助我们更好地理解工程学。
texts.en: The life signs observed within the toxic atmosphere of [From.GetName] are giant semi-organic machines! Like us, it seems like the creators of this facility appreciated a merging of the biological and mechanical. This alien industry appears to have been the cause of the noxious atmosphere on the planet, yet it's still operational. No other life signs remain on the world, and the creators of these machines must have left them running. We can't quite ascertain their purpose yet, but their construction could surely help our understanding of engineering.
